FlexiBill, unboxed

Screens come from the FlexiBill dashboard, the Billing Portal and the DOKU payment page; the plan set-up, product configuration, WhatsApp and form screens are illustrations, and all examples use sample data. Menu names can differ slightly by version and market. WhatsApp (PayChat), the Billing Portal and direct debit are available in Indonesia; Malaysia runs email invoices, the Pricing Table, coupons and card auto-debit.
